title: Namespace isolation: <base-ns>-<worktree> replaces clone stamping
description: DELETE worktree_clone.go stamping (workload/Service/Ingress rename, selector mutation, clone Services). Worktree runs apply flagged entities into derived namespace <base-ns>-<worktree>: Tilt creates it annotated tilt.dev/worktree before first apply, deletes on worktree teardown + tilt down (replaces clone GC). helm/kustomize render with --namespace <derived>; entities' namespace stamped; explicit FOREIGN namespace in a flagged blob
